digest.component_or_area: Jira DC image capability mapping and environment contract authoring tool
propositions: On-demand CI job must boot the amd64-only DC image (accessible only in CI, not on arm64 dev hosts) and interrogate its REST API to declare an authoritative environment contract rather than discover it at runtime

Capability map job must be manually dispatched, never triggered on push/PR/schedule, and must produce committed data artifacts (raw request/response evidence) for human review, not execute as a live test-path agent

Map must answer a checklist of specific structural questions: inventory (image digest, Jira version, licensed apps, project templates, issue types, field IDs for Epic Link/Name, screen configuration) and experiments (POST issuetype success, POST screen-add success, parent-field editmeta operations, sub-task Epic Link write behavior)

Map must validate four hardcoded instance vocabularies (priorities, issue types, statuses with workflow transitions, and link types with inward/outward direction) by diff against what the instance exposes, reporting present/absent/present-but-different for each entry

Link direction validation must include end-to-end round-trip testing (create issues, write links, read back raw JSON from both ends) because a direction error on symmetric link types is invisible to config-only checks and reproduces the 7f93 silent failure

Map must measure five character limit constants at limit-1/limit/limit+1 and detect accept-and-truncate by read-back comparison, plus read jira.text.field.character.limit from the instance rather than assume a hardcoded value
